reply.text:
This is a question about returning to running after pregnancy, and it touches on recovery from childbirth, which is medical. I can't give you a timeline or reassure you about when your body is ready. That one is for your doctor or a pelvic health physio, not a coach. Six weeks postpartum is exactly the point where they will check you over and tell you what is safe, and I'll train around whatever they clear.

Once they give you the go-ahead, tell me what they said and we can build your return from there. In the meantime, if you want, we can talk about what you'd like your training to look like when you're back, and I'll keep it simple.
